blocking_findings.summary: The Stage 10A fail-closed exporter policy is bypassed when legacy LangSmith tracing environment is already enabled and the new Stage 10A gate is incomplete or disabled.
evidence: core/observability.py::init_langsmith correctly forces LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 and LANGSMITH_TRACING false, removes LANGCHAIN_API_KEY, constructs no client and returns false whenever it is called.

api/main.py::_configure_optional_observability calls init_langsmith only inside `if runtime.langsmith_active`. Therefore the fail-closed cleanup is skipped whenever OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED, LANGSMITH_ENABLED or the Settings credential gate is incomplete.

Reviewer subprocess counterexample started with LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=true, LANGSMITH_TRACING=true and LANGCHAIN_API_KEY present, then used Settings with OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED=false and LANGSMITH_ENABLED=false. `_configure_optional_observability` returned (False, False) but both tracing environment flags remained true and the credential remained present.

The same isolated subprocess checked langsmith.utils.tracing_is_enabled(): it was true before configuration and remained true afterward. No trace, socket or network operation was executed by the probe.

Request-reachable legacy Manager @traceable nodes remain intentionally unaudited, so leaving legacy tracing enabled can export exactly the raw state that Attempt 2 is meant to contain. The full-opt-in countertest passes because complete gates call the cleanup; it does not cover this incomplete-gate bypass.
blocking_findings.contract_violation: Optional external tracing must be inactive unless every Stage 10A gate is satisfied, and Attempt 2 additionally requires it to remain fail-closed even with full configuration until legacy paths are audited. Returning false without forcing the effective tracing runtime off is not a valid triple gate.

required_rework.required: At the API/runtime boundary, force external Sentry/LangSmith state inactive for every configuration before any active-gate decision, including default and all incomplete gate combinations. The cleanup must reset local enabled flags, force both LangSmith tracing environment switches false, remove credential-bearing export environment, construct/init/capture nothing and remain nonfatal. Add an API-level hostile-legacy-environment matrix that calls `_configure_optional_observability` with default and incomplete Settings, asserts langsmith.utils.tracing_is_enabled() is false afterward, and asserts zero Sentry init/capture, LangSmith client and socket calls. Preserve full-config fail-closed behavior and local 10A lifecycle telemetry.

resolved_findings.evidence: Full flags plus credentials now make zero Sentry init/capture, LangSmith Client and socket calls and force tracing off. However the same cleanup is skipped at the API boundary when Stage 10A gates are incomplete, so the broader triple-gated fail-closed contract remains unresolved through REVIEW-10A-A2-001.
